note: Norms, not laws. Every check is PASS or WARN, never FAIL. [M-29] = measured from the 29 songs in the guide; [J] = guide author's judgment.

total_words.why: [M-29] median 353 words, range 218-487; checker rule [J] 280-380 with repeats written out

repeated_line_share.why: [M-29] median 58% of lines are repeats, typically 45-75%

chorus_lines.why: [M-29] 4 lines in 15 of 28 measurable choruses, range 2-11; checker rule [J] 4-8

chorus_occurrences.why: [M-29] choruses occur 3-4 times, usually doubled at the end

chorus_perfect_rhyme_share.why: [J] no more than 50% perfect rhymes in the chorus; [M-29] only 4 of 29 choruses are perfect-led

verse_lines_over.why: [J] no more than two verse lines over 16 syllables; [M-29] peaks around 18

you_count.why: [M-29] 26 of 29 songs say you/your 10+ times, median 21

title_in_chorus.why: [M-29] 10 of 29 put the title in the chorus (7 of those in line 1 or 2); never-sung titles are a legit move (guide move 9)

receipts_proxy.why: [J] 1+ number, time or place per song; [M-29] 8 of 29 have a number, 7 of 29 name a place or person

line_length_swing.why: [M-29] real songs swing from 4 to 18 syllables; uniform line lengths is a red flag (guide section 4)

anachronism.why: [J] smartphones, streaming, social apps; use the era's props instead (guide section 4)

generic-angst.why: [J] generic angst: allow one, and only if an object pins it (guide section 4)
